title: Croatian Pilaf with Jagged and Basil
description: A flavorful pilaf dish from Croatia, featuring jagged and fragrant basil. This hearty meal is perfect for a satisfying lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add jagged and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add cubed bread and cook until toasted, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in pilaf mix and cook according to package instructions.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
